description: Keep session-recall up to date — incremental sync in the background at session start (local index in solo mode, push in hub mode).

hooks.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/bin:$PATH"; log="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/session-recall-sync.log"; command -v session-recall >/dev/null 2>&1 && (session-recall sync >"$log" 2>&1 &) || echo 'session-recall: CLI not on PATH - history not synced (see README: Keeping the index fresh)' >>"$log"
